what: The literature searched in both languages (EVALUATION.md, "The literature in both languages"): what was measured off line on 2026-11-24, on the hosted collection. Ids, ranks and counts only: no question's text, no translation, no passage. A passage's language is told by oxcart/language.py; a page's grade is the judge's (codex gpt-6.1-sol, high).

direct_number.what: as served before the change: one question vector, near_vector; passages among the first 5, 20 and 50 in the same language as the question, in the other, and that cannot be told

fusion.what: the question's own list (before) and the two lists joined by reciprocal rank fusion, each list cut at a depth; RRF constant 60; the second text is the rewrite call's, made once per question

first_five_by_search.what: fused at depth 5, the first five: the grades of the passages by which search found them, and of the passages that were among the question's own five and are not among the fused five

one_document_in_both_languages.what: questions whose fused first five hold passages of one document in both languages

question_five_kept.what: the design that is served: the question's own first five always kept, up to two passages of the translation's list added (its best ones not already among them), the list ordered by reciprocal rank fusion. found = a page graded 2 among the passages shown (seven at most); found_before = among the question's own five

rewrite_call_alone.what: the rewrite call asked once for each of the 151 questions, with no earlier turn
